name: Bounded regional attention-mass redistribution
status: Exploratory sequence-split evaluation; PolypGen has informed prior analyses
question: Can a small learned preference over predicted-mask foreground, background and mixed-boundary memory keys improve Dice while retaining native temporal memory and frame scheduling?
method: At each of SAM2's four memory cross-attention layers, compute the native conditional attention read within each nonempty predicted-mask region, then redistribute the native spatial attention mass using three learned per-layer log-mass biases. Keep pointer attention mass and pointer values unchanged. Bound each bias to plus/minus ln(2). The zero-bias path returns native SDPA output exactly. Memory writing, image encoder, decoder, frame selection and all spatial memory keys remain unchanged.
provenance: SAM2 native RoPE attention and memory interfaces from the pinned official SAM2 repository
Mask-conditioned foreground/background memory grouping is conceptually related to Cutie's CVPR 2024 object transformer; Cutie's architecture is not a drop-in SAM2 module
The three-way predicted-mask grouping follows this project's frozen BPR/Mask-Transfiner mixed-cell protocol

checkpoint.note: This is the available MedSAM2 checkpoint; results are compared only against this same checkpoint's native SAM2 propagation. They do not compare to prior Hiera-B+ runs.

data.independence: Sequence-wise split; patient mapping is unverified and the full dataset has been examined in previous experiments. Exploratory only, not independent confirmation.

training.sampler: Pinned SAM2 RandomUniformSampler; clips are consecutive and begin with a positive-mask prompt
training.trainable_parameters: 12 per arm (24 total across independently trained regional and shuffled controls)
training.loss: Mean post-prompt decoder present-mask loss plus object-presence loss; SAM2 stays frozen, predicted masks are written to memory during each clip

controls.native: The same checkpoint and prompt protocol with zero regional bias; must match native SDPA exactly
controls.region-aware: Learned per-layer foreground/background/boundary log-mass biases using predicted-mask region labels
controls.shuffled-region: Same learned parameters, sample schedule and per-frame region counts, with deterministic spatial label permutation

metrics.primary: Mean present-frame Dice, first averaged within each sequence, then equally across the eight evaluation sequences

interpretation: A positive one-seed sequence-split result is a pilot signal only. Do not tune on seq16-23 or claim a general improvement from this run. If region-aware does not exceed native and shuffled on the primary metric, stop this fixed-bias formulation rather than changing weights post hoc.
